description: Search every garment Levels sells by category, brand, trade, colour, fabric, budget and more. Returns how many match, how they spread, and the best 15 with prices before a logo and links.

big_sizes.description: true when sizes above 3XL are needed

budget_max.description: number, most per blank garment in pounds

category.description: one or more of: Accessories, Aprons and tabards, Bags, Chef and catering, Dresses and skirts, Fleeces, Footwear, Gilets and bodywarmers, Headwear, Hi-vis, Hoodies, Jackets, Joggers and leggings, Knitwear, Polos, Shirts and blouses, Shorts, Softshells, Suits and tailoring, Sweatshirts, T-shirts, Towels and home, Trousers, Underwear and nightwear, Workwear overalls

colour.description: colour family, one or more of: black, blue, brown, green, grey, multi, natural, navy, orange, pink, purple, red, white, yellow

features.description: array of: waterproof, water-repellent, windproof, breathable, moisture-wicking, padded, stretch, hooded, full-zip, quarter-zip, pockets, long-sleeve, short-sleeve, v-neck, hi-vis, hi-vis-class-1, hi-vis-class-2, hi-vis-class-3, reflective, flame-retardant, 60-wash, easy-care, anti-pill, uv-protection, antibacterial, food-safe, rebrandable-label

trade.description: one of: construction, landscaping, trades-and-engineering, warehouse-and-logistics, cleaning-and-facilities, security, hospitality, catering-and-kitchen, retail, healthcare-and-care, salon-and-beauty, office-and-corporate, schools-and-education, sports-teams, fitness-and-gym, events-and-festivals, charity-and-fundraising, merch-and-gifts, outdoor-and-leisure

who.description: unisex | men | women | mixed | kids (mixed = a team of men and women; then also search women's fits)

words.description: words that must appear in the product name, e.g. 'zip' or 'oxford' (use sparingly)

name: search_products
title: Search garments
